name: PixVerse
summary: AI video generator for text-to-video, image-to-video, transitions and effects.
description: PixVerse is an AI video platform offering text-to-video, image-to-video, transitions, scene extension, an editor and ad templates. It uses its own models and also gives access to third-party video models. The company describes extending its research into real-time worlds and interactive entertainment.

howToUse.title: Open PixVerse
howToUse.description: Open PixVerse and start from a prompt on its video platform.

howToUse.title: Make a clip from text or an image
howToUse.description: Use text-to-video or image-to-video, then add transitions, scene extension, or changes in the editor.

howToUse.title: Choose models and ad templates
howToUse.description: Pick ad templates, PixVerse models, or third-party video models. The company describes this work as extending its research into real-time worlds and interactive entertainment.
